veranderings.rede: 'afdruk' means 'to print' and clashes with the letter being printed in the next sentence; plain 'druk' is what is meant and saves a word.

veranderings.voor: Hulle lees Q W E R T Y
veranderings.na: Hulle vorm Q W E R T Y
veranderings.rede: 'lees' in the sense of 'the letters read QWERTY' is an anglicism; 'vorm' is natural Afrikaans and adds no words.
